audiences.solicitor: full served evidence, conflicts, applications and provenance; privileged own-client material only
audiences.client: plain-language own-case explanation without co-defendant privilege or unsafe certainty
audiences.court: admissible/authorised material and neutral procedural states
audiences.CPS: served prosecution material and lawful disclosure; no defence privilege
audiences.internal_review: truth-key comparison and leakage audit under access control

exit_contracts: omission/containment does not count as substantive repair

source_scoring.mandatory_finding_recall: score every required finding against supporting source(s)
source_scoring.unsupported_statement_precision: penalise every unsupported or over-broad proposition
source_scoring.provenance_correctness: verify source, page/locator, speaker, date and state
source_scoring.defendant_matter_isolation: score relevance and attribution per defendant/count
source_scoring.audience_leakage: zero tolerance for privilege or unauthorised content
